VBO:0201211.summary: English, Gordon, Irish and Irish Red and White Setters are distinct bird-hunting breeds. They locate game and indicate its position; their name recalls the low “set” used when hunters caught birds with nets.
VBO:0201211.shortDescription: Four setter breeds share a bird-finding tradition, named for the low stance once used in net hunting.
